query: refactor this file, it is unreadable
expected_behavior: Detects that the touched code has no tests and says so before touching anything
Chooses exactly one of the two allowed paths and names the choice: write characterization tests first, or emit the patch marked 'NOT APPLIED — requires approval'
If it writes characterization tests, the tests pin current behaviour including behaviour that looks wrong, and a comment says so
Applies one refactoring type per batch and never mixes a rename into an extraction batch
Runs flutter analyze and the test suite after each batch, or writes the skipped-verification line verbatim when no SDK is on PATH
Reports each batch with a 'Reason safe' line explaining why behaviour is preserved
must_not: Apply edits silently without stating the missing-tests decision
Claim that analyze or tests passed without having run them
Change the discount rule's value while deduplicating it
Mix a rename and an extraction into the same batch
